resources.string: Confirm that the conviction is final, based on the court record. Prison commitment alone does not establish finality. Selecting this switch does not change custody dates or start a new time-served clock.

The court record MUST show a final conviction and establish the circumstances for the selected executive clemency category.
If the court record does not show this or you do not know the content of the court record, DO NOT SELECT A CATEGORY.

Select a court-record-confirmed category to estimate when the minimum service period for commutation review is reached. Commutation is a form of executive clemency; this reminder does not guarantee eligibility, approval or release.
If more than one category appears applicable, have counsel or the BPP confirm the applicable category.
The period uses the existing Actual Time Served counter, including recorded custody before conviction. The shared time-allowance switch controls whether net allowances count. Confirm the custody credits against the official records.
These six categories follow BPP Resolution 24-4-10, Section 4(A)(3)–(8). Other clemency routes are not assessed here. None means no category has been selected; it does not mean the person is ineligible.

string-array.name: clemency_categories
string-array.item: 10 years — One reclusion perpetua or life imprisonment sentence For crimes/offences not punished under RA 7659 and other special laws. Section 4(A)(3).
13 years — Terms adjusted to 40 years under Article 70 Indeterminate and/or definite prison terms adjusted to a definite 40-year term. Section 4(A)(4).
15 years — One reclusion perpetua or life imprisonment sentence for heinous offences Under RA 7659 or other special laws, committed on or after 1 January 1994. Section 4(A)(5).
18 years — Reclusion perpetua or life imprisonment for specified offences RA 6425 (as amended), RA 9165, kidnapping for ransom, terrorism, plunder or transnational crimes. Section 4(A)(6).
20 years — Two or more reclusion perpetua or life imprisonment sentences Including sentences adjusted to 40 years under Article 70. Section 4(A)(7).
25 years — Original death sentence reduced or commuted Automatically reduced or commuted to reclusion perpetua or life imprisonment. Section 4(A)(8).

resources.string: The calculated service period for the selected category has been reached. Seek review for commutation of sentence.
